description: JavaScript code for managing Wi-Fi neighbor status page, including UI initialization, scanning, and data handling.

methods.name: set_ui_init
methods.description: Initializes UI elements with Wi-Fi neighbor data, setting Wi-Fi mode and security info.

methods.name: _lock_scan
methods.description: Enables or disables scan buttons for different bands.

methods.name: start_scan
methods.description: Starts Wi-Fi scan on specified band, with checks for band enablement.

methods.name: scrolled
methods.description: Synchronizes horizontal scroll of table headers.

methods.name: set_info_success_2g_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful 2G info retrieval, triggers data fetch.

methods.name: set_info_error_2g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 2G info fetch, including logout on 403.

methods.name: set_info_success_5g_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful 5G info retrieval, triggers data fetch.

methods.name: set_info_error_5g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 5G info fetch, including logout on 403.

methods.name: set_info_success_6g_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful 6G info retrieval, triggers data fetch.

methods.name: set_info_error_6g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 6G info fetch, including logout on 403.

methods.name: set_info_data
methods.description: Sends Wi-Fi neighbor info data to API for setting, with success/error callbacks.

methods.name: get_info_error_2g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 2G info retrieval, including logout on 403.

methods.name: get_info_error_5g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 5G info retrieval, including logout on 403.

methods.name: get_info_error_6g_cb
methods.description: Handles errors during 6G info retrieval, including logout on 403.

methods.name: get_info_success_2g_cb
methods.description: Processes successful 2G Wi-Fi neighbor data, manages scanning state.

methods.name: get_info_success_5g_cb
methods.description: Processes successful 5G Wi-Fi neighbor data, manages scanning state.

methods.name: get_info_success_6g_cb
methods.description: Processes successful 6G Wi-Fi neighbor data, manages scanning state.

methods.name: get_info_data
methods.description: Fetches Wi-Fi neighbor info data for specified band.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Stores retrieved object data into global variable.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Handles error during object data fetch, including logout on 403.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Requests object data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page by fetching object data.
